title: Vulnerability Scanning Lab - GVM/OpenVAS with Docker
description: Build a full Greenbone Vulnerability Manager (GVM) stack locally using Docker Compose. Covers feed sync, scan target config, and report export.

title: Web App Pentest Lab - DVWA + Juice Shop + Proxy
description: Spin up multiple intentionally-vulnerable web apps in an isolated Docker network with mitmproxy and Burp Suite integration.

title: SIEM Lab - Wazuh Stack (Manager + Indexer + Dashboard)
description: Deploy the complete Wazuh SIEM stack with Docker Compose. Enroll agents, write custom detection rules, forward alerts to the dashboard.

title: Network IDS/Forensics Lab - Suricata + Zeek
description: Run Suricata and Zeek side-by-side in Docker, replay PCAP files, write custom rules, and correlate alert output.

title: WordPress Institutional Site & Academic Portal Assessment
description: Nine findings: 4 Medium (XSS-vulnerable plugin, open XML-RPC, unthrottled SIAKAD & CBT logins), 3 Low, 2 Info.

title: Broken Access Control / Improper Resource Isolation
description: Low-privilege SDR account can view organization member records and research batch metadata.

title: TLS Certificate Expired & Hostname Mismatch
description: Expired TLS certificate with hostname mismatch enabling potential MITM against authenticated users.

title: Backend Services Exposed to Public Internet
description: API, object storage, and PostgreSQL directly reachable from public internet, bypassing nginx proxy controls.

title: Directory Listing / Information Disclosure
description: Public-sector web application returns full directory listing to unauthenticated users.

title: Missing Anti-Framing & Login Brute-Force Protection
description: Clickjacking via missing framing headers and absent login rate-limiting on a production web dashboard.
